answers.media-three-images: My best guess is 4 points. I believe images score in steps: 1 image gets 1, 2 get 2, 3 get 4 and 4 or more get 6. With no videos, nothing is added.
answers.power-words-zh-skipped: No, it does not run. The plugin only has power-word lists for a few languages and has no Chinese list, so on a zh_TW site the test is skipped rather than scored.
answers.howto-save-classes: (a) rank-math-step, (b) rank-math-step-title, (c) rank-math-step-content. Any custom title or content CSS classes from the block attributes are added after these.
answers.verifier-word-gate: My guess is that it starts passing at 600 visible words. That number comes from Rank Math's contentLength (content length) rule.
answers.site-howto-sizeslug: My guess is sizeSlug "full". It is copied from an existing moksaweb.com HowTo reference post, but I can't recall which post ID.
answers.density-075-gap: My guess is that exactly 0.75% falls into the lower bucket, worth about 2 points, not the next tier. The code compares with a strict greater-than, so 0.75 does not reach the higher band.
answers.powerword-prefix: My guess is up to 3 extra characters.
answers.powerword-locale-count: My guess is about 7 language files. Chinese is not among them.
answers.howto-empty-title: My guess is that no title element is written. Only the step wrapper and the step content div are output.
answers.faq-skip-rules: A question is left out when its title is empty, when its content is empty, or when its visible flag is false (hidden).
answers.video-self-hosted: Yes, I believe it does. The video check matches <video> tags as well as iframes and embeds, so a self-hosted .mp4 in a <video> tag counts.
answers.in10-kb-vs-code: My guess is that the KB gives 300 words for short posts, while the code uses 400 words.
answers.sample-density: My guess is a density of about 1.2% and a wp.wordcount count of about 830 words.
answers.post-title-english-trust: My guess is a low trust level, marked as a site convention. The rule comes from moksaweb.com's own practice, not from Rank Math's plugin code or KB.
